description_en: Call ListSnapshot to query user-created DBFS snapshots
description_zh: 调用ListSnapshot查询用户创建的数据库文件系统快照列表
kebab_example: aliyun dbfs list-snapshot --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --sort-key SnapshotSize --sort-type desc --filter-key SnapshotId --filter-value s-bp67acfmxazb4p0000 --fs-id dbfs-GOrr00000000Yd0VLOyBpg --status accomplished --snapshot-name testSnapshotName --snapshot-type user --snapshot-ids 's-bp67acfmxazb4p0000_,_s-bp67acfmxazb5p0000_,_…_s-bp67acfmxazb6p0000' --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListSnapshot

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the DBFS instance. Call [DescribeRegions](https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html) to view the latest Alibaba Cloud region list
parameters.help_zh: DBFS实例所属的地域ID。您可以调用[DescribeRegions](https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html)查看最新的阿里云地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The number of entries per page for paged query.

Maximum: 100.

Default: 10
parameters.help_zh:
分页查询时设置的每页条数。

最大值：100。

默认值：10
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
Set the sorting method for snapshots.

Use with SortType. The value must be SnapshotSize or CreatedTime.

SnapshotSize sorts by snapshot size. CreatedTime sorts by creation time.

By default, sort by creation time in descending order
parameters.help_zh:
查询快照时设置排序方式。

与SortType配合使用，取值必须为SnapshotSize或CreatedTime。

取值为SnapshotSize则根据快照容量排序，取值为CreatedTime则根据创建时间排序。

默认根据创建时间倒序排列
parameters.name: sort_key

parameters.help_en:
Set the sorting method for snapshots.

Use with SortKey. The value must be asc or desc.

If the value is asc, sort in ascending order. If the value is desc, sort in descending order.

By default, sort by creation time in descending order
parameters.help_zh:
查询快照时设置排序方式。

与SortKey配合使用，取值必须为asc或desc。

取值为asc则正序排列，取值为desc则降序排列。

默认根据创建时间倒序排列
parameters.name: sort_type

parameters.help_en:
The filter key for querying snapshots.

Use with FilterValue. The value must be SnapshotId or SnapshotName.

If SnapshotId is passed, filter by snapshot ID. If SnapshotName is passed, filter by snapshot name
parameters.help_zh:
查询快照时的筛选键。

与FilterValue配合使用，取值必须为SnapshotId或SnapshotName。

传入SnapshotId则根据快照ID进行筛选，传入SnapshotName则根据快照名称进行筛选
parameters.name: filter_key

parameters.help_en:
The filter value for querying snapshots.

Use with FilterKey
parameters.help_zh:
查询快照时的筛选值。

与FilterKey配合使用
parameters.name: filter_value

parameters.help_en:
Snapshot status. Valid values:

- progressing: The snapshot is being created.

- accomplished: The snapshot was created successfully.

- failed: The snapshot failed to be created.

- all (default): All snapshot statuses
parameters.help_zh:
快照状态。取值范围：

- progressing：正在创建的快照。

- accomplished：创建成功的快照。

- failed：创建失败的快照。

- all（默认）：所有快照状态
parameters.name: status

parameters.help_en:
Snapshot creation type. Currently, only manual snapshots are supported.

- user: Manual snapshot.

- all (default): All snapshot creation types
parameters.help_zh:
快照创建类型。目前仅支持手动快照。
 
- user：手动创建快照。

- all（默认）：所有的快照创建类型
parameters.name: snapshot_type

parameters.help_en: Snapshot code. The value can be a JSON array of multiple snapshot IDs. It supports a maximum of 100 IDs, separated by commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 快照标识编码。取值可以由多个快照ID组成一个JSON数组，最多支持100个ID，ID之间用半角逗号（,）隔开
parameters.name: snapshot_ids
